title: Jack Stewart's wingman saw object turn and follow

tellings.difference: Places it near New Orleans and adds that the object shot past the cockpit and was first taken for a balloon. The pilot is not named.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of a pilot's wingman seeing an object turn around and follow the jet, the Jack Stewart incident that Graves relays.

as_told.title: Object chases a jet near New Orleans

plain: A Navy pilot named Jack Stewart flew past an unknown object, and his wingman, the pilot flying beside him, told him afterward: "Yeah, dude. That thing turned around and followed you." The writer Marik von Rennenkampff passes this on, crediting Stewart and the former Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves. Graves tells a version without naming the pilot: near New Orleans an object shot past a cockpit and was first taken for a balloon, until the wingman saw it turn and chase the jet, which would mean it was something under control rather than drifting.
